limitations: Every claim was verified by direct reproduction (pre-fix RED, post-fix GREEN, and for two fixtures an isolated clean-main repro of the unrelated downstream bug that blocks a full clean exit). field-regression-cli-smoke.ts and worktree-authority-smoke.ts were deliberately NOT registered into lattice.config.json validate.commands, since doing so would make lattice validate fail repo-wide on the two separately-tracked, unrelated bugs (task_9f6b2322, task_a8d49518) rather than this story's own fixed defects -- this is a documented, deliberate CHK-004 decision, not an oversight.
pitfalls: Root cause investigation for all three bugs required reading production source directly (PROCESS_FACT_REGISTRY/buildBoundedSourceGraph for CHK-001, command-catalog.ts's required readManifest for CHK-002, core/version-bump.ts's unconditional readFileSync assumptions for CHK-003) rather than trusting surface symptoms. Two RED scripts initially failed to capture their target signature because execFileSync's pipe-based stdio capture silently truncates large synchronous crash dumps at 8192 bytes on macOS -- fixed by switching to spawnSync with a real file descriptor (captured as a new dev-memory lesson, id 8445435). Fixing CHK-002 and CHK-003 each unmasked a DIFFERENT unrelated pre-existing bug further down the same file (the same class of masking issue documented in B-a7c5's dev-memory lesson 6d3f770) -- each was verified via isolated reproduction (temporary scratch-skip / clean-main worktree) rather than assumed unrelated, then correctly excluded from scope and flagged as its own follow-up. A separate meta-guard (red-b49d4-harness-registration.mjs) caught that the 3 new RED scripts needed either registration or an explicit exclusion reason, requiring one extra DEV->REVIEW round. A stale ws@8.20.0 dependency resolution in this worktree's node_modules (vs the correct ws@8.21.1 in packages/main's own lockfile) caused an unrelated tsc lint failure at the REVIEW->TEST gate, fixed by reinstalling packages/main's dependencies directly.
